text:
mei: putting postmortem follow-ups here (INC-4822). We saw ramp + cache-priming overlap blow past our blast radius assumptions. want concrete telemetry + tiny controls.

ben: agree. propose two short wins: 1) add cohort-level kv-miss metric tied to each rollout, 2) enforce "max_shards" per flag to limit blast radius.

rachel: for (1) I can add a rollout label to our metrics pipeline; takes ~1 day. that will let dashboards break out by cohort.

ton y: for shard limits, what's a sensible default? 3 shards? 5?

ben: start with 3 for new flags, 5 for migrated ones. have a flag attribute `blast_radius_limit`.

infra-sre: we also need blackout coordination with batch jobs. recommend a small repo change to list heavy jobs and expose their windows: `infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml`.

mei: yes — add that repo entry and a pipeline check to block ramp schedules overlapping those windows. owner: rachel. due: 4 business days.

rachel: taking owner for job-window registry + pipeline check. will add a validation step in release CI.

support-ops: request: please add a short support playbook for forced rollbacks so on-call can explain to customers. 3 bullet template ok.

ben: I'll write the rollback playbook. minimal automation first: detect >250ms p95 increase OR error-rate delta >= 2% sustained for 4m => rollback.

mei: can we also require a 2-step confirmation for Dedicated tenants? some customers want manual rollback only.

ben: yes. default auto-rollback ON for self-serve; OFF for Dedicated. include tenant opt-out metadata.

tony: small policy draft for gating. here's a YAML sketch:
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  blackout_windows:
    - start: "01:30"
      end: "03:00"
      tz: "UTC"
  blast_radius_default: 3
  dedicated_auto_rollback: false
```
will add as PR.

rachel: telemetry SQL to spot risky flags (draft):
```sql
SELECT f.flag, r.rollout_id, AVG(kv_miss) as avg_kv_miss, SUM(errors) as errs
FROM rollouts r
JOIN flag_metrics f ON f.rollout_id = r.rollout_id
WHERE r.started_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY f.flag, r.rollout_id
HAVING AVG(kv_miss) > 0.08 OR SUM(errors) > 10
ORDER BY avg_kv_miss DESC;
```
putting this into a weekly report.

infra-sre: created INF-1145 for shard limits + blackout CI check, assigned to rachel + tony.

devops-bot: ticket INF-1145 created and linked to CI pipeline job `rollout-safety-check`.

mei: follow-ups summary: (job-window registry + CI check: rachel, 4d), (blast_radius attribute + shard limit enforcement: tony, 5d), (rollback playbook & rule: ben, 2d), (support template: support-ops, 3d), (telemetry + weekly report: rachel, 7d). I'll add these to postmortem tracker and ping PMs.

ben: plan to run a 7-day shadow run on staging with traffic replay after we have metrics. will coordinate with infra-sre.

rachel: will also add a lint that flags flags without owner metadata during PRs.

ton y: ack and will open PR for policy YAML tonight.

mei: thanks — please post PR links here when available. we want the CI checks in before next deploy window.

support-ops: ack. drafting short customer note for rollback notifications.

infra-sre: also adding a monthly alert in our incident board to surface recent rollouts that had kv-miss spikes.

mei: perfect. closing loop: i'll update the incident follow-ups doc and assign calendar reminders. ping here if anything slips.
